scope: Current 2026 House publication and all-candidate inventory

extracted_skip_reasons: Five legacy publication tests require superseded image fixtures intentionally excluded from current downloads.
One repository-only historical byte audit requires its original audit receipt.
verification.article_and_mobile_visual_review: All eight current figures; previews refreshed after final donor-label edits.

remaining_limitations: Provider returns are a provisional November 12-13 snapshot, not certified results or a ballot-access census.
A complete roster is not complete trait coverage; acquired biography sources cover only the two major parties.
Machine-extracted biography facts require subject verification and remain model-ineligible.
Religion and race/ethnicity are not coded in the new all-candidate inventory; no identities are inferred.
Historical donor scores and 2023-2024 voting records are not current campaign ideology.
Existing selective model samples are not expanded by inventory coverage and do not establish causal candidate effects.
Detailed static labels and footnotes require enlargement at narrow phone widths.
